title: The planetary nebula NGC 3132 revisited: high definition 3D photoionization model

evidence.locator: Abstract: the three-dimensional density structure obtained from SAM-FP data at SOAR by assuming homologous expansion. Sect. 2.1: a field of 180 x 180 arcsec at 0.18 arcsec a pixel; an instrumental line width of 26.8 km/s. Sect. 3.1: velocity cubes of H-alpha and [N II] 6584 turned into density, intensity going as density squared; the main dense inner ring's symmetry axis inclined about 30 degrees to the line of sight, a low-density cavity along an axis about 20 degrees from it. Sect. 1: the bright A star's Gaia DR3 geometric distance, 754 pc (+18, -15), is taken as the nebula's. Sect. 4: a dynamical age of 2061 ± 412 yr from the fitted velocity field. "All files used in generating the final Mocassin model have been made available at https://github.com/hektor-monteiro/NGC3132_model."
